panels.title: Coverage & readiness
panels.description:
### Recovery readiness
Verified backup and restore evidence must be no older than 24h. Investigate OPEN readiness or missing evidence using the backup age and scoped alerts.

Health probes and container state describe availability, not product correctness. Request rate, latency and submission throughput are not collected. Host alerts outside this scope remain in existing dashboards.
